text: 鲸鲸朗读是面向 dsh-go 手机 App 原生界面的语音插件，通过原生 audio/media 桥接播放合成音频，并在面板提供配置与状态。它可长按助手回复朗读或导出 MP3，也能朗读会话最新回复、试听语音、停止播放和切换服务商。语音由小米 MiMo 或豆包 Seed 合成，回复会先清理 Markdown 并分段缓存，回合结束后可后台预取。适合希望在手机原生界面收听 DSH 回复并保存音频的用户。使用前需要配置所选服务商的 API Key；豆包还需音色 ID。

Whale Voice brings speech to the native dsh-go mobile app. Long-press replies to listen or export MP3. Its panel supports preview, stop, and Xiaomi MiMo or Doubao Seed. Replies are cleaned, segmented, cached, and optionally prefetched. Set a provider API key; Doubao needs a voice ID.

鲸鲸朗读的功能「朗读回复」：长按助手消息触发语音合成，并通过手机 App 的音频能力播放；可选择小米 MiMo 或豆包 Seed 服务商。
鲸鲸朗读的功能「导出音频」：长按消息选择存成音频，插件合成可用片段并写出 MP3 文件，再在面板展示导出历史和路径。
鲸鲸朗读的功能「后台预取」：助手回合完成后，插件可自动清理文本、分段并在后台合成缓存，用户之后点按即可播放已准备的音频。
鲸鲸朗读的功能「朗读设置」：面板可编辑语音服务商、API Key、音色、语气和分段长度，也提供试听、停止及缓存清理操作。
鲸鲸朗读会把待朗读文本发送给所选语音服务商合成音频；需要配置对应 API Key，豆包还需音色 ID。

local-voice README · dsh-go-local-voice · 鲸鲸朗读：

[English](./README.en.md) · 中文 > 面向 **dsh-go 手机 App 原生界面**的 TTS 插件（不是网页版） 给 **[DeepSeek Harness / dsh-go](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 手机 App 原生界面**用的语音朗读插件： 长按任意一条回复 →「读出来」，用**小米 MiMo TTS**（或字节 **豆包 Seed TTS**）合成，直接在 App 里播放。 > 为什么需要它：DSH 生态里的 TTS 插件大多只跑在 **Harness 网页版**——它们的声音靠浏览器的 Web Audio 播， > Flutter 原生界面里根本不会触发。这个插件走的是 dsh-go 桥接的 `audio` 能力，所以能真的出声。

local-voice README · 功能：- **长按回复 → 读出来**；也可以「存成音频」导出到手机存储（MP3）
- **小米 MiMo**：`mimo-v2.5-tts` 内置 8 个音色（冰糖 / 茉莉 / 苏打 / 白桦 / Mia / Chloe / Milo / Dean），可加语音指令（语气、方言、情绪）
- **豆包 Seed TTS**：`seed-tts-2.0` / 声音复刻 `seed-icl-2.0`（走 HTTP v3 单向流）
- **长文一次念完**：回合结束后台分段预取，点一次交出去的是**一整段**音频，不是"点一次念 120 字"
- **可停止**：`停止` 按钮真的停得住（固定的播放实例 + 稳定的 lease）
- **实时状态**：输入框上方状态条显示 `正在合成语音…` / `朗读中 0:12 / 1:40`；面板里有进度条
- **音频历史**：导出过的文件在面板里列出来，点一下复制路径
- Markdown 清洗：代码块、链接、表格、行内代码都不会被念出来（链接读作"链接"）

local-voice README · 安装：插件目录放在 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-go/plugins/` 下（`DSH_HOME` 默认 `~/.dsh`）：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/27Synthesis/dsh-go-local-voice.git \
  "$HOME/.dsh/dsh-go/plugins/local-voice"

dsh plugin --profile web add "$HOME/.dsh/dsh-go/plugins/local-voice"

装完在 App 里**重启一次引擎**（设置 → 引擎 → 重启引擎），然后：

- 长按助手消息 → 菜单里出现「读出来」「存成音频」
- 输入框上方「插件」胶囊 →「鲸鲸朗读」

卸载：`dsh plugin --profile web remove local-voice`，再删目录。

local-voice README · 配置：第一次用先在主面板里点「打开设置」，填 API Key：

| 项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 小米 Key | 在 [小米 MiMo 控制台](https://platform.xiaomimimo.com/console/api-keys) 申请，形如 `sk-...` |
| 豆包 Key | 在[豆包语音控制台](https://console.volcengine.com/speech/new/setting/apikeys)申请（标准音色与 Agent Plan 都支持） |
| 豆包音色 ID | 形如 `zh_female_...`；用声音复刻时填复刻音色 ID |
| 每段字数 | 默认 140。约 0.08 秒/字，140 字≈11 秒，稳在单次 30 秒的生产预算内 |
| 自动预取 | 默认开。回复一结束就在后台把整条合成好，之后点「读出来」几乎秒播 |

**Key 只存在本机** `data/settings.json`（权限 0600），不会进仓库、不会出现在界面里、不会发给模型。
`data/` 已在 `.gitignore` 中。

local-voice README · 它是怎么做到的（给想改代码的人）：dsh-go 原生插件的桥接协议（v1.2）有三条硬约束决定了实现方式：

1. **`media` 路由必须在 30 秒内产出字节**（`CAP_LIMITS.mediaMs`）——这是*生产预算*，不是音频时长上限。
2. 音频本身可以很长（≤16 MiB），App 拿到整段自己播；`play` / `stop` 作用在同一个 `instance` 上。
3. 插件**不能主动推播放效果**：`onCapability` 的返回值不会被执行成效果，所以"播完自动接下一段"做不到。

于是：
section: 它是怎么做到的（给想改代码的人）

text:
local-voice README · 它是怎么做到的（给想改代码的人）：- **预取**：`session/event` 的 `turn/end`（completed）时，把回复按 140 字切段、并发 3 合成到 `data/cache/<sha1>/sNNN.mp3`，全齐后拼成 `all.mp3`。
- **播放**：`read` 只建任务并立刻返回 `{type:'audio', op:'play', instance:'read', src:'media:speech', key}`；App 回来 `GET` 媒体路由，插件把缓存拼成**一个整段 MP3**（MP3 裸帧直拼是合法的，没有 ID3 头）。
- **冷缓存**：最多等 15 秒，先交已经合成好的前几段（约 30～60 秒语音），剩下的后台继续；10 分钟内再点一次从上次停的地方接着念。

实测（小米 MiMo v2.5 TTS，非流式 mp3，手机网络）：15 字≈2.4 s，60 字≈4.7 s，120 字≈8.3 s，
240 字≈38 s（**超预算**），400 字≈32.6 s，800 字≈54.9 s → 这就是为什么段长取 140。

text:
local-voice README · 踩过的坑：- **`instance` 必须固定**（这里用 `read`）。每次播放换新实例名，`stop` 就找不到 lease，"停止"永远按不动——不是接口不支持。
- **面板的 `select` 下拉框不可靠**：音色改成 `list` 一行一个、点一下立刻写设置 + toast + `refresh`。
- **状态必须走数据绑定**（`{"$": "data.info.status"}`）：视图里写死文字的话，每秒推数据界面也不会变。
- **主面板只用 v1 组件**（stack/text/callout/progress/list/keyValue/actions），需要输入框的项放「朗读设置」面板（v2）。

local-voice README · 已知限制：- **不能"回复结束自动开口"**：协议只允许用户点按触发播放。
- 小米目前没有语速参数（豆包有 `speech_rate`，面板还没暴露）。
- 暂停 / 继续：桥接的 `pause` 实测不可靠，已移除。
- 单次播放音频上限 16 MiB（约 5.5 分钟语音），超长回复会在后台继续合成、下次点按接着念。
- 豆包那一路没有 Key 实测过（按 v3 单向流接口写的），首次使用请先短句试听。

local-voice README · 排查：- `data/debug.log`：点按、媒体字节数与耗时、`audio.ended/stopped/error`、预取情况（不记 Key、不记正文）
- `data/settings.json`：当前配置（0600）
- 自查：`node $DSH_HOME/skills/dsh-go-plugin/kit/bin/check.mjs <本目录> --load`

local-voice README · 致谢：- 思路与小米/豆包接口细节参考了 [**dsh-xiaomi-tts**](https://github.com/ppy-web/dsh-plugin-xiaomi-mimo-tts)（MIT）——它是网页版实现，播放侧用浏览器 Web Audio，本仓库是面向 dsh-go 原生界面的独立实现。
- 插件格式与桥接能力来自 [deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的 dsh-go 插件协议。

local-voice README · dsh-go-local-voice：

[中文](./README.md) · English Text-to-speech for the **native dsh-go phone app** (not the web UI). Long-press any assistant reply → **Read aloud**, synthesized with **Xiaomi MiMo TTS** (or ByteDance **Doubao Seed TTS**) and played inside the app.

local-voice README · dsh-go-local-voice：> **Why this exists:** most DSH TTS plugins only work in the Harness **web** client — they play audio through the browser's Web Audio API, which never fires inside the Flutter native UI. This plugin uses the dsh-go bridge's `audio` capability instead, so the sound actually comes out of the phone.

local-voice README · Features：- **Long-press a reply → Read aloud**; or **Save as audio** to export an MP3 to phone storage
- **Xiaomi MiMo**: `mimo-v2.5-tts` with 8 built-in voices (冰糖 / 茉莉 / 苏打 / 白桦 / Mia / Chloe / Milo / Dean) plus a free-form speech instruction (tone, dialect, emotion)
- **Doubao Seed TTS**: `seed-tts-2.0` and voice cloning `seed-icl-2.0` (HTTP v3 unidirectional stream)
- **Whole reply in one shot**: the reply is segmented and pre-synthesized in the background after each turn, so one tap hands the app **one continuous MP3** — not "120 characters per tap"
- **Stop actually works**: a stable playback instance keeps the audio lease alive (`stop` is bound to the same instance)
- **Live status**: a strip above the composer shows `正在合成语音…` / `朗读中 0:12 / 1:40`, and the panel has a progress bar
- **Export history**: exported files are listed in the panel; tap one to copy its path
- Markdown is cleaned before speaking: code blocks, tables, inline code and URLs never get read (links become "链接")

local-voice README · Install：The plugin directory lives under `$DSH_HOME/dsh-go/plugins/` (`DSH_HOME` defaults to `~/.dsh`):

```bash
git clone https://github.com/27Synthesis/dsh-go-local-voice.git \
  "$HOME/.dsh/dsh-go/plugins/local-voice"

dsh plugin --profile web add "$HOME/.dsh/dsh-go/plugins/local-voice"

Then **restart the engine once** in the app (Settings → Engine → Restart), and:

- Long-press an assistant message → **读出来 / Read aloud**, **存成音频 / Save as audio**
- Composer → **Plugins** capsule → **鲸鲸朗读**
local-voice README · Install：Uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile web remove local-voice`, then delete the directory.

local-voice README · Configure：| Field | Notes |
|---|---|
| Xiaomi Key | From the [MiMo console](https://platform.xiaomimimo.com/console/api-keys), looks like `sk-...` |
| Doubao Key | From the [Doubao speech console](https://console.volcengine.com/speech/new/setting/apikeys) (standard or Agent Plan keys) |
| Doubao voice ID | e.g. `zh_female_...`; for cloning, the cloned voice ID |
| Chars per segment | Default 140. Roughly 0.08 s per character, so 140 chars ≈ 11 s — inside the 30 s production budget |
| Auto-prefetch | On by default. Synthesizes the whole reply in the background right after the turn, making later taps nearly instant |

local-voice README · Configure：**Keys stay on the device** in `data/settings.json` (mode 0600). They are never committed, never rendered in a view, and never sent to the model. `data/` is in `.gitignore`.

local-voice README · How it works：The dsh-go native plugin bridge (protocol v1.2) imposes three constraints:

1. A `media` route must **produce its bytes within 30 seconds** (`CAP_LIMITS.mediaMs`). That is a *production* budget, not an audio-length limit.
2. Audio may be long (up to 16 MiB); the app plays it locally, and `play` / `stop` act on one `instance`.
3. A plugin **cannot push playback on its own** — values returned from `onCapability` are never executed as effects, so "auto-continue to the next segment" is impossible.

local-voice README · How it works：- **Prefetch**: on `turn/end` (`completed`), split the reply into ~140-char segments, synthesize up to 3 concurrently into `data/cache/<sha1>/sNNN.mp3`, and concatenate into `all.mp3` when complete.
- **Playback**: `read` creates a job and immediately returns `{type:'audio', op:'play', instance:'read', src:'media:speech', key}`. The app then `GET`s the media route, and the plugin serves **one concatenated MP3** (bare MP3 frames concatenate legally — there is no ID3 header in the response).
- **Cold cache**: wait at most 15 s, hand over whatever segments are ready (roughly 30–60 s of speech), keep synthesizing in the background, and continue from the stopping point if tapped again within 10 minutes.

local-voice README · How it works：Measured on a phone connection (MiMo v2.5 TTS, non-streaming mp3): 15 chars ≈ 2.4 s, 60 ≈ 4.7 s,
120 ≈ 8.3 s, 240 ≈ 38 s (**over budget**), 400 ≈ 32.6 s, 800 ≈ 54.9 s — hence 140 chars per segment.

local-voice README · Traps worth knowing：- **The `instance` name must be stable** (here: `read`). Using a fresh instance per playback makes `stop` fail to find its lease — that bug is easy to misread as "the API doesn't support stopping".
- **Don't rely on a `select` dropdown for voice choice.** Use a `list` where one tap writes the setting, toasts, and refreshes; mark the active voice with a check.
- **Status text must be data-bound** (`{"$": "data.info.status"}`). If it is baked into the view, pushing data once a second changes nothing on screen.
- **Keep the main panel on v1 components** (stack/text/callout/progress/list/keyValue/actions); put anything needing text inputs in a separate panel that uses v2 forms.

local-voice README · Known limits：- **No "speak automatically when the reply ends"**: the protocol only allows playback triggered by a user tap.
- MiMo has no speed parameter (Doubao has `speech_rate`, not yet exposed in the panel).
- Pause / resume: the bridge's `pause` is unreliable in the app, so it was removed.
- One playback is capped at 16 MiB (≈5.5 minutes of speech); longer replies keep synthesizing in the background and continue on the next tap.
- The Doubao path was written against the v3 unidirectional-stream API but **has not been tested with a real key** — try a short sentence first.

local-voice README · Troubleshooting：- `data/debug.log` — taps, media byte counts and timings, `audio.ended/stopped/error`, prefetch activity (no keys, no message text)
- `data/settings.json` — current configuration (0600)
- Self-check: `node $DSH_HOME/skills/dsh-go-plugin/kit/bin/check.mjs <this directory> --load`

local-voice README · Credits：- API shapes and voice lists were informed by [**dsh-xiaomi-tts**](https://github.com/ppy-web/dsh-plugin-xiaomi-mimo-tts) (MIT) — a browser-side implementation. This repository is an independent implementation for the dsh-go native UI.
- Plugin format and bridge capabilities come from [deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).
